subject.title: fix(cron): mark interrupted restart runs failed instead of lost

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's focused SQLite/runtime proof for the durable cron restart-recovery state change, or require full gateway restart proof before landing?
rationale: The patch is a narrow fix, but it intentionally retimes a persisted cron marker used for restart recovery, and automation cannot choose the team's desired proof bar for that session-state behavior.

options.title: Accept focused runtime proof
options.body: Land after normal required checks if the SQLite-backed production-module proof and focused regressions are enough for this durable marker timing change.

options.title: Require full gateway restart proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted full gateway stop/restart transcript showing the interrupted cron task becoming failed rather than lost before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept focused runtime proof
recommendation.body: Land after normal required checks if the SQLite-backed production-module proof and focused regressions are enough for this durable marker timing change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to this PR and has recent history in the same cron timer behavior surface.
